title: Etale unit cohomology and inhomogeneous cocycles
statement: For every field K, GaloisUnitsTwoCocycleClasses K [def-sc-galois-units-two-cocycle-classes], with the Krull topology on Gal(Ks/K) and discrete natural separable-closure unit coefficients [def-sc-galois-units-cohomology], is in bijection with H²(Spec(K)_et,G_m), the cohomological Brauer group [def-br]. This comparison uses continuous inhomogeneous cochains and does not use the homogeneous cochain model.

proof.text: Choose an algebraic closure of Ks as geometric residue field and apply the abelian stalk equivalence. Etale neighbourhoods yield finite separable extensions, so the stalk of invertible functions is Ksˣ, including in imperfect characteristic. The action-on-germs formula gives its natural Galois action.

The stalk equivalence identifies global sections naturally with invariants. An exact equivalence preserves injectives; transporting an injective resolution and applying this identification termwise identifies etale cohomology with derived invariants.

Continuous cochains on discrete modules form an exact cohomological delta-functor: a continuous map from compact finite powers of G has finite image and its values can be lifted on finite clopen partitions. Embed each module by its orbit map into locally constant coinduced functions with right translation. In positive degrees the insertion homotopy h_n(F)(g1,...,g(n-1))(x)=F(x,g1,...,g(n-1))(1) satisfies d h+h d=1 by cancellation. Compactness gives open stabilizers of these functions and continuity of the homotopy into their discrete topology. This effaces positive cohomology; uniqueness of universal delta-functors identifies it with derived invariants. This argument applies to abelian groups, with no finite-ring hypothesis.

In degree two the kernel equation and preceding image relation are exactly those of the explicit quotient. The canonical lift/down equivalences in gmSheaf are additive and equivariant and induce inverse maps on cochains and on cohomology. Forget group structures to obtain the desired type equivalence.
